info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Leucite Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Leucite Battery Detail Catalog API facilitates the addition of detailed information for Leucite battery products. It allows businesses to create comprehensive catalog entries, including specifications, pricing, and availability. This API is particularly useful for manufacturers and retailers looking to enhance their product offerings and improve transparency for consumers. By leveraging this endpoint, users can streamline the process of catalog management and ensure that their data is up-to-date and accurate.

post.summary: Create a new leucite battery detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail entry for a leucite battery. It expects the necessary data in the request body, which should adhere to the specified format. The new entry will be stored and a response will be returned indicating the result of the operation.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details necessary for processing leucite battery information. It includes specific operational parameters and configurations in JSON format.

200.description: Successful response with requested battery details.
